dog.description_text:
Meet Mable, a sweet little girl with quite the travel story and an even bigger dream of finding her forever home.

Thanks to Hope4Fur and the Andrew Sabin Family Foundation, Mable made the incredible journey all the way from China to New York to escape the Chinese meat trade and get the chance at the happy, carefree life every dog deserves! She's traded a scary past for the promise of soft beds, endless belly rubs, and a family who will love her forever.

Mable has already crossed an ocean to get a second chance. Now all she needs is someone to make her feel like she's finally home.
